catalyst.name: Chain Reaction, Rampage, Xenophage Catalyst
catalyst.description:
Weapon Kills grant a Stack of Rampage. Maximum of 3 Stacks. Stacks expire one at a time every 🡅4.5 seconds.
Grants a 10%|21%|33.1% damage increase at 1|2|3 Stacks.
Weapon Kills trigger a solar elemental explosion, dealing up to 109 [72.8] damage in a 3 meter radius.
